title.en: Chapter 12 — The Serpent and the Board

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: العملاق حس فينا وصار يرمي حجار.
sentences.en: The giant sensed us and began throwing stones.
A big stone broke half the raft.
Only two companions were left with me.

sentences.ar: وصلنا جزيرة تانية ونمنا من التعب.
sentences.en: We reached another island and slept from exhaustion.
At night, a very long snake came.

sentences.ar: ربطت حالي بين ألواح خشب عريضة.
sentences.en: I tied myself between wide wooden boards.

sentences.ar: الحية ما قدرت تفتح تمها عليّ.
sentences.en: The snake could not get its mouth around me.
In the morning, a ship passed and saw me.
